module "LayerBlend.dsf"

product 0 MaterialLayerBlend "Layers/MLB_LiOverlay" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = FunctionInput(BlendInputRelevance="Bottom", InputName="Under", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=0) : material @L3:C1 "Under"
  %1 = FunctionInput(BlendInputRelevance="Top", InputName="Over", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=true, SortPriority=1) : material @L3:C1 "Over"
  %2 = GetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%0) : [BaseColor:float3, EmissiveColor:float3, Roughness:float, Normal:float3, Opacity:float, WorldPositionOffset:float3, FrontMaterial:Substrate, MaterialAttributes:material] @L19:C32 "BaseColor"
  %3 = GetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%1) : [BaseColor:float3, EmissiveColor:float3, Roughness:float, Normal:float3, Opacity:float, WorldPositionOffset:float3, FrontMaterial:Substrate, MaterialAttributes:material] @L19:C49 "BaseColor"
  %4 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.5), ParameterName="Alpha", SortPriority=32) : float @L6:C9 "Alpha"
  %5 = Lerp(%2, %3, %4) : float3 @L19:C27 "BaseColor"
  %6 = MakeMaterialAttributes(BaseColor=%5) : material @L3:C1
  %7 = FunctionOutput(%6, OutputName="Attrs", SortPriority=0) @L3:C1 "Attrs"
  inputs %0, %1
  outputs %7
